ev.q: During 2016, 10.1% of all ED visits in the United States were made by patients with depression
By age, the highest percentage of ED visits by patients with depression was for visits by patients aged 35–64 years (14.8%)
During 2016, 10.1% of all ED visits in the United States were made by patients with depression
A higher percentage of visits to the ED were made by females with depression (12.1%) compared with males with depression (7.8%).
This same pattern was present for all three age groups.
Based on a sample of visits to EDs in noninstitutional general and short-stay hospitals
Source: National Center for Health Statistics, National Hospital Ambulatory Medical Care Survey, 2016.

methods_quotes.q: With 95% confidence intervals indicated with error bars.
